visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a pair of silver chopsticks lifting a large, tangled clump of thin, pale yellow noodles from a white ceramic bowl. Beneath the noodles, fresh green bean sprouts and small slices of pale pork are visible. The background is dark and out of focus, while the lighting is bright and direct on the food. (2) The scene cuts to a middle-aged woman with glasses, a pink t-shirt, and a black apron working in a traditional kitchen setting. She stands behind a large stainless steel counter with steaming vats. She uses a ladle to pour dark sauce into a white bowl, surrounded by various metal containers and kitchen utensils. (3) A close-up view transitions back to the food, specifically a bowl of dry noodles being mixed with chopsticks. The noodles are coated in a glistening translucent sauce. The setting is a simple indoor restaurant with wooden tables and bright overhead lighting that reflects off the wet surfaces of the meat and sprouts. (4) The camera focuses on a different bowl containing wide, flat white noodles (guo-zi) topped with pork slices. A hand pours dark vinegar from a plastic bottle and then spoons red chili bean paste onto the dish. The background remains the neutral, slightly cluttered environment of the dining area. (5) Several bowls of soup are displayed, one featuring chopped green onions and a large poached egg, while another contains wontons. The camera pans slightly to show plates of 'hei-bai-qie' side dishes, including sliced seaweed, pig blood cake, and various organ meats garnished with ginger slivers and green onions. (6) A hand holds up a white paper ordering slip with printed text and checkboxes. The final scene shows the humble storefront of the noodle shop from the street. It features a simple metal counter, plastic stools, and a red lantern hanging from the eaves under bright daylight.
